frozen_candidate_root_contribution: A static, self-assumed bodily posture-state (حال) predicated of persons/collectives in the eschatological assembly — the manner in which the gathered are, as distinct from where they are or the act of gathering them. Non-transitive, non-agentive-toward-a-patient, morally unrestricted. The specific physical geometry of the posture (e.g. 'kneeling' vs crouching/collapsed/lowered) is NOT fixed by Quran-internal evidence and is deliberately left open.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root ج ث و occurs 3 times, all nominal active participles in the accusative circumstantial (حال) slot: جِثِيًّا (19:68, 19:72) and جَاثِيَةً (45:28). The two surfaces are one participial lexeme differing only by number/gender agreement with their referents (plural humans vs the fem-sg collective كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ). In every case it names the bodily state in which sentient beings are found at the Judgment gathering — brought around Hell (19:68), left in it (19:72), or seen at the summons to the record (45:28). The internal evidence fixes the semantic class (a posture-state of the assembled) but underdetermines the exact posture; the traditional gloss 'kneeling' is compatible with but not derivable from the packet.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT encode location: position is carried by separate prepositions حَوْلَ ('around', outside — 19:68) and فِيهَا ('in', inside — 19:72), and the same word جِثِيًّا attaches to both, so the root supplies posture not place. Does NOT encode the act of assembling: it is distinct from and consequent to لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ / لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ (19:68) and is not redundant with حشر. Does NOT entail guilt or punishment: 45:28 predicates جَاثِيَةً of كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ ('every nation'), morally unrestricted. Not transitive/agentive-on-a-patient, not a motion or event, and not an affective/moral state (piety is lexicalized separately as ٱتَّقَوا۟, 19:72). Does NOT internally fix a specific limb-geometry ('on the knees').
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 45:28 (جَاثِيَةً) predicates the posture of كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ ('every nation'), universally and before the record-based sorting, disproving the tempting narrowing 'jvw = posture of the damned/punished' that 19:68 (devils+deniers) and 19:72 (ٱلظَّالِمِين) alone would support; the punitive coloring belongs to those referents and to جهنم/فيها, not to the root, whose own contribution is a morally-neutral posture-state.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That jvw denotes collective 'massing/heaping / being brought together in crowds' rather than an individual bodily posture — supported by حشر framing and حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ (19:68) and the group quantification كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ (45:28). It is rejected as the primary account because the active-participle morphology agrees in number/gender with the subjects (a per-subject state), 19:72 applies it to ٱلظَّالِمِين فِيهَا where 'assembling in crowds' is not salient, and 'assembling' is already lexicalized by حشر, making a 'massed' reading redundant with its own context. What survives either reading — 'a settled/lowered static condition of the assembled' — is retained as the narrowest common denominator.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: That jvw denotes collective 'massing/heaping / being brought together in crowds' rather than an individual bodily posture — supported by حشر framing and حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ (19:68) and the group quantification كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ (45:28). It is rejected as the primary account because the active-participle morphology agrees in number/gender with the subjects (a per-subject state), 19:72 applies it to ٱلظَّالِمِين فِيهَا where 'assembling in crowds' is not salient, and 'assembling' is already lexicalized by حشر, making a 'massed' reading redundant with its own context. What survives either reading — 'a settled/lowered static condition of the assembled' — is retained as the narrowest common denominator.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three analysts (A, B, and adversary C) converge with no dissent: one root nucleus, one participial class, no unbridged sense-split, no resistant occurrence. The functional nucleus (posture-state of the assembled at Judgment) is coherent across 3/3 occurrences and is distinguished from semantic neighbours by demonstrable surface evidence — posture ⟂ location (حَوْلَ vs فِيهَا) and posture ⟂ moral status (كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ). Strength is capped at MODERATE, not STRONG: n=3, all in a single low-variance حال/eschatological frame (Maryam ×2, al-Jāthiya ×1), the exact condition under which 'fits everything' is cheap ('CONSISTENT ≠ universally established'). The specific posture identity is held UNRESOLVED as an honest sub-terminus, but the class-level nucleus is a genuine root-wide generalization.

reconciliation.rationale: No contradiction once sequence is respected: in 19:71–72 the God-fearing are first saved (نُنَجِّى), so those remaining in the jvw-state are necessarily the wrongdoers; 45:28's كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ is the controlling universal. The punitive coloring is carried by the referents and فِيهَا, not by the root, so 19:72 instantiates the same morally-neutral posture-state nucleus.

(1) The punitive-narrowing hypothesis ('posture of the damned') was tested against 45:28 كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ and failed — the root's contribution is morally neutral. (2) The location hypothesis was tested against the حَوْلَ (19:68) vs فِيهَا (19:72) minimal pair on the identical word جِثِيًّا and failed — location is carried by prepositions, not the root. The posture-state nucleus survived both with no failing occurrences, and is distinct from its neighbours (location, حشر/assembling). The narrower 'specific posture (kneeling)' sub-claim remains UNRESOLVED, but the class-level nucleus that was falsification-tested held.

Non-transitive, non-agentive-toward-a-patient, morally unrestricted. layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 3/3 occurrences: 19:68:8:1 (جِثِيًّا, حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ), 19:72:8:1 (جِثِيًّا, ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا), 45:28:4:1 (جَاثِيَةً, كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ) — all accusative حال of the gathered at Judgment.
layer_attribution.derivation: Single active-participle derivation: جاثٍ (fāʿil) → broken plural جِثِيّ (agreeing with plural human referents) and fem-sg جَاثِيَة (agreeing with the fem-sg collective أُمَّة); qac_pos N, qac_verb_form null throughout; no finite verb attested.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One nominal/participial lexical class (posture-state حال descriptor); no lexicalized sub-split — the جِثِيّ/جَاثِيَة difference is agreement, not sense.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Eschatological assembly register (ḥashr, Fire-proximity, summons to the record). This narrative setting supplies the punitive/duress coloring in Sūra 19 but is NOT promoted into the root claim — the root contributes posture, the context contributes location and moral valence.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 19:72's restriction to ٱلظَّالِمِين is reconciled with 45:28's universal كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ by sequence (the God-fearing are saved first, نُنَجِّى, so only wrongdoers remain in the state near the Fire); this yields consistency, not partition.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No occurrence resists the class-level nucleus. The single honest residue is that the specific physical identity of the posture ('kneeling' vs crouching/collapsed/lowered/massed) is Quran-internally underdetermined by 3 non-contrastive tokens and is held UNRESOLVED; the inherited 'kneeling' gloss is a lexicon prior barred as authority by source policy.

hard_cases.reason: Universalizes the posture to كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ before record-based sorting, refuting a punitive/guilt-specific narrowing and sharpening the negative boundary posture ⟂ moral status.

evidence_basis.statement: 45:28 (جَاثِيَةً) predicates the posture of كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ ('every nation'), universally and before the record-based sorting, disproving the tempting narrowing 'jvw = posture of the damned/punished' that 19:68 (devils+deniers) and 19:72 (ٱلظَّالِمِين) alone would support; the punitive coloring belongs to those referents and to جهنم/فيها, not to the root, whose own contribution is a morally-neutral posture-state.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence resists the class-level nucleus; the one genuine hard case is the adversarial boundary at 45:28, whose universal quantifier كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ is the load-bearing datum that fixes the negative boundary (posture ⟂ moral status) and defeats the punitive narrowing. Its statement is persisted verbatim as strongest_counterexample.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence of root jvw in which the participle denotes location or the act of assembling rather than a bodily posture-state, OR a finite verb / non-حال usage that fixes a specific limb-geometry — any of which would overturn the claim that the root's universal contribution is a location-independent, morally-neutral posture-state of the assembled.
rejection_condition.search_location: The three packet occurrences (19:68:8:1, 19:72:8:1, 45:28:4:1) and any future-attested jvw form; specifically test whether the posture reading survives independently of the co-occurring prepositions حَوْلَ / فِيهَا and of the referents الشياطين / الظالمين.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each verse_text and check (a) whether جِثِيًّا/جَاثِيَةً occupies the حال accusative slot, (b) whether spatial information is carried by a separate preposition rather than the root, and (c) whether the referent set includes morally-unrestricted subjects (كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ).
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Isolate the root's contribution from context by comparing 19:68 (حَوْلَ, outside) against 19:72 (فِيهَا, inside): identical word, opposite location, so location is a confounder to be stripped; and compare 45:28 (كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ) against 19:72 (ٱلظَّالِمِين) to strip the punitive-referent confounder.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If posture cannot be separated from location or moral status, the universal posture-state nucleus collapses and the account must be downgraded to LOCAL/UNRESOLVED or re-partitioned into location-bound vs posture-bound classes.

reopen_conditions: If a new jvw occurrence appears with a finite verb form (qac_verb_form non-null) or outside the حال accusative slot, re-test whether the posture-state class still partitions all occurrences or whether a verbal/eventive class must be split off.

If a jvw occurrence appears outside the eschatological/Judgment register (e.g. a worldly or non-gathering context), re-test the negative boundary posture ⟂ location and whether the nucleus generalizes beyond the current single frame.

If internal evidence emerges that contrastively fixes limb-geometry (naming knees, sitting, or falling) at any jvw occurrence, reopen the currently-UNRESOLVED specific-posture sub-claim and consider upgrading result_strength.

If the scope tension between 45:28 (كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ, universal) and 19:72 (ٱلظَّالِمِين, restricted) is challenged by a new occurrence, re-examine the sequence-based reconciliation (نُنَجِّى before نَذَرُ).

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: Two genuine refutation routes were run. (1) The punitive-narrowing hypothesis ('posture of the damned') was tested against 45:28 كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ and failed — the root's contribution is morally neutral. (2) The location hypothesis was tested against the حَوْلَ (19:68) vs فِيهَا (19:72) minimal pair on the identical word جِثِيًّا and failed — location is carried by prepositions, not the root. The posture-state nucleus survived both with no failing occurrences, and is distinct from its neighbours (location, حشر/assembling). The narrower 'specific posture (kneeling)' sub-claim remains UNRESOLVED, but the class-level nucleus that was falsification-tested held.
